articles.title: Airlines: Why Delta is best in class 'in a rowdy class'
articles.mainIdea: Airlines: Why Delta is best in class 'in a rowdy class'
articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: Airlines: Why Delta is best in class 'in a rowdy class'. After Delta Air Lines (DAL) released its fourth quarter earnings results, Morningstar equity analyst in aerospace and defense Nicolas Owens reacts to the airline operator's order for Boeing (BA) Dreamliners, premium travel bookings, and how geopolitical tensions could weigh on air travel. Also watch Nicolas Owens explain why Delta's 2026 growth promises may be too lofty. To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Morning Brief. Related tickers mentioned: DAL.

articles.title: Boeing annual orders top Airbus for first time since 2018
articles.mainIdea: Boeing annual orders top Airbus for first time since 2018
articles.summary: AFP: Boeing annual orders top Airbus for first time since 2018. Boeing secured orders for nearly 1,200 commercial planes last year, topping European rival Airbus for the first time since 2018, according to figures released Tuesday.Airbus has dominated deliveries in recent years in the aftermath of the two crashes of Boeing 737 MAX planes that occurred in 2018 and 2019, respectively. Related tickers mentioned: DAL, EADSF.
